profiling.purpose: Attribute recurring GC pauses and sustained fresh-process CPU variation in identical binaries
profiling.scope: Diagnostic only; EventPipe and JIT output affect execution. No product gate can pass from these observations.
profiling.coverage: Entire process, including preparation, continuous 480-second warmup, 180-second measurement and finalization
profiling.decision: Match GC reason/pause intervals to retained maxima, compare Tier1 code across processes, and inspect CPU stacks. Preserve all samples. Missing events or attribution remain inconclusive.

plan.causal_variable: CPU sampling enabled only in B; GC tracing, JIT output, product binary and all workload settings match
plan.warmup_rationale: 480 seconds continuous workload after observer heap preparation; previous 360-second captures retained helper/ConditionalWeakTable JIT near total seconds 382-400. Collect 180 seconds to retain multiple recurring GC cycles, not select a GC-free window.
plan.observer_preparation: After histogram allocation, two blocking compacting full GCs with finalizer waits before workload warmup; no forced GC during warmup or measurement
plan.report_aggregation: all overflow sorting and aggregation deferred until both captures finish
plan.histograms: Exact ticks, touched buckets only; 65536 distinct ticks/interval, shared archive capped at 4194304 entries (64 MiB); exhaustion invalidates
plan.phase_transition: one continuous warmed call loop; no return/re-entry between warmup and measurement
plan.jit_attribution: CLR MethodJittingStarted; identical observer in all phases
plan.phase_order: For each control workload, run A1 then B then A2 before starting the next workload
plan.endpoint: 127.0.0.1:9092; literal loopback avoids external OS DNS in cached-transport probes
plan.scope: Cached-transport completed administrative calls; no network/broker acceptance.
plan.verdict: INCONCLUSIVE: partial scope; assess all retained runtime and metric evidence

code_and_cpu.scope: Diagnostic only; code identity does not prove identical host costs and code differences do not prove CPU causality.

sampled_cpu.Note: Raw stack sample counts, not CPU percentages or elapsed times. Waiting/native samples remain labeled by the original payload.
